text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Sounds of Earth, not bad...! Her running 
is definitely the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
This year's Derby might be really 
interesting...! I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bennnnnissimo!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel it! Both my running and the 
crowd's reaction...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(From here, I must connect the sound 
toward the Derby... This is a crucial 
part. I have to play it with delicate 
precision...!)

—And so, Sounds of Earth made a 
magnificent impression at the Kyoto 
Shimbun Hai with her running and her 
music!
――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, is that the social media of that 
girl named Sounds of Earth?”

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I started following them a while ago. 
They share quite a bit of info that makes 
racing a whole lot more fun, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there was some kind of update 
just now, though—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now— It is time for music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What I play now is a melody dedicated to 
the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Titled: "Gathering of the Stars".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Eighteen radiant lights gather... each 
carrying their own dreams and stories...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let us convey every last bit of that 
brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"I ran pretty well in the Satsuki Sho 
too...! I know I can do it in the Derby, I 
just know it...!"

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become the strongest Umamusume 
of my generation...!"

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let anyone say I'm just coasting 
on my parents' coattails. I'll show them 
that I can become a GⅠ Umamusume too...!"

text_block_list.name: Earth's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"‘Take the Derby...! And then spread your 
wings to the world...!!’"

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: "I want to reach them—I truly do."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"Before Trainer retires... I want to bring 
them the title of Derby Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"I finally made it this far... I 
absolutely cannot lose...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ――They run.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Carrying their own dreams, they gather for 
the decisive battle: the Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, I want you to see the rest with your 
own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of race the Japanese Derby 
will become...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
—Ohh...! That's so passionate...! To think 
Peerless Shout had a story like this 
behind it...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting super excited for the Derby! 
Man, I wonder who's gonna win...—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene! What a splendid reaction...!

It was a musical commentary performed from 
Sounds of Earth's perspective, featuring 
the Umamusume running in the Japan Derby, 
based on her own idea.

It reached the passionate race fans, and 
seemed to help raise anticipation for the 
Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I was reminded once more of the power 
of music. Grazie, direttore!
choice_data_list: You really don't need to thank me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I was reminded once more of the power 
of music. Grazie, direttrice!
choice_data_list: You really don't need to thank me.

text_block_list.text:
This achievement was only possible thanks 
to Sounds of Earth's dedicated passion to 
liven up the race. Therefore—
choice_data_list:
...Let's keep hyping things up together 
from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! With our music and our running, let us 
get the crowd roaring together!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And————glorious victory will be seized in 
these hands!

"The battleground that will decide the 
pinnacle of the generation, the Nippon 
Derby, is just around the corner—"
